Faqs.title: Still have
Faqs.description: Here are some answers to the most frequently asked questions. If you don't find what you're looking for, feel free to contact us.

faqs.question: Why is web design important for my business?
faqs.answer: A professional web design is your best 24/7 salesperson. It enhances first impressions, increases credibility, improves search engine visibility, and converts visitors into customers. A well-designed website can boost your brand’s perceived quality by up to 80%, according to Stanford studies.

faqs.question: How long does it take to design a website?
faqs.answer: We create custom websites in 1-3 weeks, depending on complexity. We work in agile phases: strategic planning (1 week), custom design (1-2 weeks), and technical development (1-3 weeks). You'll see visible progress from the very first week!

faqs.question: What information do I need to provide to start building my website?
faqs.answer: We need three key elements: 1) Business information (mission, values, target audience), 2) Branding materials (logo, colors, fonts), and 3) Basic content (photos, descriptive texts).

faqs.question: Do you provide ongoing support after launch?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer support and post-launch maintenance plans to ensure your website stays up-to-date and performs optimally.

faqs.question: What services do you offer?
faqs.answer: We provide tailored digital solutions, including landing page and website design and development, as well as custom software. We also create intuitive UI/UX designs, develop custom CRMs, integrate artificial intelligence into your processes, and optimize eCommerce stores with Shopify. Additionally, we implement automations and workflow optimizations using various tools and AI to enhance your business efficiency. Let's take your project to the next level! 🚀

faqs.question: What if I don't like the delivered design?
faqs.answer: Throughout the project, we maintain constant communication and gather your feedback to ensure the final result meets your expectations. Once the website is delivered, you’ll have a revision available for any minor modifications you may need.

faqs.question: Can you help me with SEO?
faqs.answer: Although our main focus is on design and development, we always aim to optimize your site's basic SEO and provide guidance to improve its visibility.
